sources.title: Tag or lock up long-term? Colts face upcoming decisions on two of team’s best players
sources.description: According to CBS Sports Joel Corry, the Indianapolis Colts should already be anticipating lucrative looming pay days again for a pair of pending 2027 free agents: starting left guard Quenton Nelson and running back Jonathan Taylor respectively.
